title: Strict chain model data for union comparison arrows
statement: For the comparison arrows on U ⊔ V, U, V and U ⊓ V, there are strict chain maps t,t',α,β with t≫β=α≫t' and derived-category isomorphisms from A,B,Cone(t),A',B',Cone(t') to the six displayed vertices.

source.place: Tags 08HZ, 08HY and 0DJ9, chain-level K-injective restriction construction

proof.text: Choose the functorial K-injective replacement I of a complex representing K. The quasi-isomorphism to I gives Q(I) ≅ K, and every term of I is injective. Form the concrete restriction/direct-image complexes J_W for W = U ∪ V, U, V, U ∩ V. Apply schemeOpenUnionImageComplex_shortExact to obtain the short exact row J_(U∪V) → J_U ⊞ J_V → J_(U∩V). The constructed open-image comparison identifies Q(J_W) with Rj_W* of exact restriction of K. Repeat for K′ on X′ and the inverse-image opens.

Apply the short-exact-sequence triangle construction to each row, then apply Rf* followed by Lg* to the first and Rf′* to the second. Derived direct image is triangulated. Equip Lg* with the shift structure adjoint to the right-derived shifts; Mathlib Adjunction.isTriangulated_leftAdjoint makes it triangulated. By DerivedCategory.mem_distTriang_iff, each image triangle is isomorphic to a localized mapping-cone triangle. Project the inverse triangle isomorphism at its three vertices and use the additive biproduct comparison. This gives two independent chain maps t and t′ and the three vertex isomorphisms for each.

Identify exact open restriction with derived pullback by left-adjoint uniqueness and compose direct images by the right-adjoint mate of the pullback composition comparison. For the target row, identify the inverse-image open with the chosen fibre product via pullbackRestrictIsoRestrict. Pullback along this scheme isomorphism is an equivalence: the pullback composition and identity isomorphisms give its fully faithful structure, so its adjunction unit is invertible. Apply Rj to that unit and use right-adjoint uniqueness for the resulting composite to transport the localized object to the fibre-product object. Apply Rf′ and its composition comparison. Inverse image preserves union and intersection. These constructions give exactly the six required object isomorphisms.

Set α = 0 and β = 0. The zero-composition laws give t ≫ β = α ≫ t′. Package the two cone models and six object isomorphisms with True.intro. No equation relating α, β or the cone map to the original comparison morphisms is requested by this statement; neither compactness nor quasi-coherence is needed.

proof_origin.place: Tag 08BV applied on an arbitrary union; mem_distTriang_iff; Adjunction.isTriangulated_leftAdjoint. Object-only route written and compiled by Q4.
